info.description:
Internationalized culture / e-commerce / custom-travel platform for Jingdezhen ceramic art.
Backend in Go + Fiber; money as BIGINT minor units (CNY base, USD/EUR/GBP presentment).
info.title: Jingdezhen Ceramics Platform API

get.description:

Locale resolution: ?locale= overrides Accept-Language.
Fetches a single published artist by its locale-specific slug.

404.description: Artist not found (or not published in this locale)

get.description:
Returns the signed-in user's cart, enriched with display info
for the requested locale. Optional ?currency= adds presentment
totals + per-line presentment prices (USD/EUR/GBP; FX-snapshotted).
Stock is advisory at this stage (authoritative decrement at checkout).

parameters.description: Presentment currency (USD/EUR/GBP). Adds presentment totals + per-line prices.
parameters.name: currency

post.description:
Adds a SKU to the cart. POST is additive: the existing qty for
this SKU is incremented by qty (defaults to 1). A qty exceeding
available stock returns 409 (advisory; authoritative decrement
is at checkout).
post.summary: Add an item to the cart

parameters.description: Item to add (qty optional, defaults to 1)
parameters.name: body

404.description: SKU not in cart or does not exist

409.description: Quantity exceeds available stock

delete.description: Removes all listed SKUs from the cart. Returns the count removed.
Removes a SKU from the cart entirely (not a decrement).
delete.summary: Remove an item from the cart

404.description: SKU not in cart or does not exist

patch.description:
Sets the quantity for a SKU in the cart to exactly qty (absolute,
not additive). A qty exceeding available stock returns 409.

400.description: Invalid SKU ID / body / validation / qty < 1

404.description: SKU not in cart or does not exist

409.description: Quantity exceeds available stock

post.description:
Merges a guest localStorage cart (posted on login) into the
signed-in user's server cart. Each guest item is upserted
additively, capped at the SKU's stock. Returns the merged cart
(same shape as GET /cart). Optional ?currency= adds presentment.
post.summary: Merge a guest cart into the server cart

get.description: Distinct categories across published products (bare strings for MVP).

Paginated list of published products in the requested locale.
Supports filtering by category, artist, and tags (ANY-match).
Locale resolution: ?locale= overrides Accept-Language.

parameters.description: Comma-separated canonical tag keys (ANY-match, e.g. hand-painted,celadon-glaze)
parameters.name: tag

get.description: Returns a product's ordered gallery for the storefront. No auth.

Fetches a single published product by its locale-specific slug,
with SKUs, gallery, and tags loaded. Optional ?currency= adds
presentment pricing to each SKU (USD/EUR/GBP; FX-snapshotted).

parameters.description: Presentment currency (USD/EUR/GBP). Adds `price` + `price_currency` to each SKU.
parameters.name: currency

404.description: Product not found (or not published in this locale)

get.description:
Tags attached to at least one published product, with the
locale-resolved display name + a product count.

Public authenticity-certificate lookup by its JDZ-<6-base32> code
(the QR target). Returns the cert + product/artist display info +
the provenance chain. No auth.

Serves the pre-rendered certificate PDF (302 redirect to the
storage/CDN URL). ?download=1 forces an attachment; otherwise inline.
404 when the PDF has not yet been generated (local mode / pre-render).
No auth.

302.description: Redirect to the PDF storage URL

404.description: Certificate not found / PDF not yet generated

get.description:
Renders a QR PNG encoding the public certificate URL on-demand.
Returns image/png (cached 24h; QR is stable per code). No auth.

post.description:
Converts the signed-in user's cart into an order: authoritative
atomic stock decrement, FX-snapshot of presentment + CNY totals,
address snapshot, shipping calculation. Returns the created
order (with a hosted checkout URL in sandbox/live mode; empty
in mock mode where the order auto-succeeds).
Currency defaults to the user's preferred_currency (or USD).
Gateway required in sandbox/live (airwallex|paypal); ignored in mock.
post.summary: Place an order from the cart

parameters.description: Checkout details (address must belong to the user)
parameters.name: body

400.description: Invalid body / validation / empty cart / unshippable / overweight / unsupported currency

409.description: Insufficient stock to place the order

Cancels the signed-in user's order. Only unpaid (status=created)

404.description: Order not found (or not owned by user)

409.description: Only unpaid orders can be cancelled

get.description: Returns all shipping addresses for the signed-in user.
get.summary: List the current user's shipping addresses

post.description:
Adds a shipping address to the signed-in user's address book.
Set is_default=true to also make it the default.

parameters.description: Address to create (country is ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)
parameters.name: body

Replaces all editable fields of an address. is_default is honoured

it's also manageable via the set-default endpoint.

404.description: Address not found (or not owned by user)

delete.description: Removes one of the signed-in user's addresses.

404.description: Address not found (or not owned by user)

404.description: Address not found (or not owned by user)

get.description:
Public preview of the shipping fee for a country + packed weight,
computed from the shipping_fee_tiers table. Returns shippable=false
(with a reason) for unshippable countries or overweight packages.

400.description: Invalid country (must be 2 letters) / weight (must be non-negative grams)

post.description:
Receives Airwallex payment events. Verifies the signature via
the gateway, then acks 200 immediately (enqueue-and-ack). A
signature mismatch returns 400. Idempotent on the idempotency_key.

Receives PayPal payment events. Verifies the signature via the
gateway, then acks 200 immediately (enqueue-and-ack). A signature
mismatch returns 400. Idempotent on the idempotency_key.

get.description:
Paginated list of the signed-in user's favorited SKUs, enriched
with the parent product's display info for the requested locale.
Locale resolution: ?locale= overrides Accept-Language.

post.description:
Favorites a SKU. Idempotent: favoriting an already-favorited
SKU is a no-op (still returns 201). A nonexistent SKU returns 404.
post.summary: Add a SKU to the wishlist

delete.description: Unfavorites a SKU. Removing a SKU not in the wishlist returns 404.
delete.summary: Remove a SKU from the wishlist

author_name.description: joined from users (nickname, fall back to email)

item_count.description: sum of distinct SKUs (not sum of qty)

product_title.description: Display fields populated by the locale-aware JOIN (public page) — db:"-"

notes.description: "anything else we should know" (step 4 free text)

user_id.description: optional: link to a platform user

tags.description:
Tags is a list of canonical tag keys (lowercase kebab-case). Unknown keys
are created inline with an en-US display name defaulting to the key itself
(the operator edits the name later from the CMS).

public_url.description: PublicURL resolved at read time by the storage adapter. Not in DB.

hosted_url.description:
HostedURL is the gateway's hosted-checkout URL (sandbox/live). Empty in
mock mode. The client redirects the customer here to pay off-site.

items.description: Items loaded by the service (detail view only).

artist_name.description: populated by service (joined or from artist_translations)

category.description: parent: bare string for now (dead post-media; kept for back-comat)

gallery.description:
Gallery loaded by the service (detail view only). Empty when no
product_media rows. The first item's media PublicURL is the preferred
thumbnail; ThumbnailURL above is the fallback for back-comat.

skus.description: SKUs loaded by the service (detail view only; omitted from list view).

tags.description:
Tags loaded by the service (list + detail views; batch-loaded to avoid N+1).
`Name` is the locale-resolved display name (en-US → key fallback).

thumbnail_url.description: parent: primary display (dead post-media; gallery preferred)

media.description: The media asset, loaded via JOIN. Embedded so the JSON nests it.

price.description:
Presentment-currency price (populated when the request carries ?currency=).
Nil when no conversion was requested. TDD §7: converted at read time from
the cached fx_rates, with the PRD rounding rule applied.

tags.description:
Tags replaces the full tag set (absolute, like cart PATCH). nil = leave
unchanged; an empty slice = clear all tags. Values are canonical keys.

BearerAuth.description: "Bearer <access_token>" — JWT access token from POST /auth/login (or OAuth). Required for all /admin/* and customer-authed endpoints; omitted for public /catalog/* reads.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
